login.eyebrow: Grades 6 – 9 · B1 → B2 · 30 minutes a day
login.title: English grammar
login.intro: Sign in with the username and password your teacher gave you.
login.locked: This account is locked. Please ask your teacher.
login.wrong: Wrong username or password. If you forgot your password, ask your teacher to reset it.

join.askToMove: To change class, ask the teacher of your current class.
join.title: Enter your class code
join.intro: Your teacher gives you a 6-character code (for example AB12CD). Each student joins a class once; to change class, ask your teacher.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.intro: Mistakes your teacher notes after each piece of writing. Those still marked "Still making it" come first in review before new lessons.
progress.none: You have not done any lesson yet.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.googleHint: You sign in with Google. Set a password if you also want to sign in with your email and a password (Google keeps working).
account.tooShort: The new password needs at least 6 characters.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
account.sameAsOld: The new password must differ from the current one.
account.weak: The new password is too weak: use at least 6 characters with letters and digits.
account.changed: Password changed. Use the new password next time you sign in.
account.set: Password set. You can now also sign in with {email} and this password.
account.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your teacher to reset it on the student management page.

roadmap.title: Class {name} roadmap
roadmap.intro: Your teacher gives the class each lesson when it is time. Work is saved automatically; each lesson is submitted once.
roadmap.empty: No lesson has been given to class {name} yet. Your teacher will give lessons when the class starts them.

errors.againTitle: The student made this mistake again

review.notSubmitted: Not submitted yet: these are answers in progress, not graded.

assign.noClasses: No class in this grade yet
assign.givenTitle: Given to {name} - click to take back

editor.keywordTitle: Highlight in blue a keyword / pattern to remember
editor.strikeTitle: Strike through in red a wrong form
editor.heading: Heading
editor.warnTitle: Yellow box for common mistakes / notes
editor.tableTitle: Insert a 3 × 3 table (first row is the header)
editor.addColTitle: Add a column to the right
editor.notFound: lesson not found, or you may not edit it
editor.pickGrade: Choose a grade for the lesson.
editor.noId: could not create a lesson id
editor.intro: A lesson belongs to a grade and starts given to no class. Only classes it is given to (on the class page, or ticked below) see it and can do it.
editor.hasAttempts: Students have already done this lesson
editor.hasAttemptsText: Students' results are tied to each question, so the questions can no longer change. Create a new lesson (you can use this one as the template and copy its content).
editor.notMineText: You can only edit lessons you created. You can still preview it, give it to a class on the class page, or create a new lesson from its structure.
editor.noPhases: This grade has no terms yet
editor.assignNow: Give to classes now (optional - you can do it later on the class page)
editor.assignLater: Give or take back the lesson on each class's page.
editor.step2Help: Pick a starting point, then add, remove and reorder the sections. You write the questions in the next step.
editor.nextNeed: Choose a grade, a term and at least one section to continue.
editor.withContent: Copy its questions too, to edit
editor.label: Label
editor.lessonTitleEx: e.g. My House - there is / there are
editor.subtitle: Line under the title
editor.deleteConfirm: Click again to delete the lesson

structure.standardDesc: Explanation, flashcards, multiple choice, gap-fill, ordering, writing
structure.examDesc: Pronunciation, True / False reading, cloze, matching, error finding
structure.replaceConfirm: Click again - the sections you are writing will be replaced
structure.mineEmpty: None yet. Build a structure below and click “Save structure”.
structure.outlineEmpty: No sections yet. Pick a starting point above or add sections one by one.
structure.saveAs: Save this structure as a template
structure.overwriteConfirm: A template has this name - click again to overwrite
structure.saveHelp: A template keeps the sections, titles, hints and number of questions, never the questions themselves. Only you see your templates.

lessonDelete.warn: Permanently delete “{name}” with its sections and questions. This cannot be undone.
lessonDelete.warnAssigned: The lesson is given to {n} class(es) ({classes}); deleting it takes it away from them.
lessonDelete.hasAttempts: Students have already done this lesson, so it cannot be deleted: their results belong to it. Use “Close” on the class page to stop taking work.
lessonDelete.denied: This lesson could not be deleted: you can only delete lessons you wrote, or it is already gone.

preview.note: Preview of what you are writing (not saved). Try it like a student; nothing is saved.

sectionEd.previewTitle: See this section as students will
sectionEd.removeConfirm: Click again to delete the section

sectionEd.bodyHelp: (use the toolbar for bold, highlights, example boxes, tables…)

sectionEd.whyEx: every day → present simple; he → goes.

sectionEd.errorChunksHelp: (separated by / - each part is an option A, B, C…)

lessonPage.saveError: Not saved - check your connection; your work will be saved on your next change
lessonPage.waitComment: Submitted · waiting for the teacher's comment
lessonPage.previewNote: Preview: answers and explanations are shown under every question. You can still try it; nothing is saved.
lessonPage.giveHelp: ✓ = given: students of that class see and do this lesson. Click to give or take back.

closed.title: This lesson is closed
closed.text: Your teacher has stopped taking work for this lesson.

locked.title: 🔒 This lesson is not open to you
locked.text: Your teacher has not opened this lesson to you. Ask your teacher if you need to do it.

open.title: This lesson has not been given to your class
open.text: Your teacher will give it when the class gets to it.

lessonPage.dueNote: When time is up the lesson closes and your answers are submitted automatically.
lessonPage.result: Result: {ok}/{total} correct. See the answers and explanations under each question.
lessonPage.blockedClosed: The lesson is closed (or past its deadline), so you cannot continue. What you answered will be submitted automatically.
lessonPage.blockedLocked: Your teacher has not opened this lesson to you, so you cannot continue.
lessonPage.submittedWait: You have submitted. Your score and the answers appear once your teacher has graded it.
lessonPage.howTo: Answer every question, then press Submit at the bottom. You can change answers until you submit; each lesson is submitted once.

classPage.notFound: Class not found, or you are not assigned to teach it.
classPage.autoSubmitted: {n} answers in progress were submitted automatically.
classPage.closedReview: Students can still review what they submitted.
classPage.released: Results released for {n} submissions. Students now see their scores and the answers.
classPage.dueInPast: The deadline must be in the future.
classPage.dueSet: Deadline set to {date}. When it passes the lesson closes and work in progress is submitted.

help.give: Lessons of the grade are not given to any class yet. Click Give to class ▾ to see what the lesson contains and choose the deadline, who gets it, results at submit and shuffling, then click Give to class in that panel: only then can this class's students see and do it.
help.who: The whole class may do it by default; use 👥 to open it to some students only.
help.close: Close stops taking work: answers in progress are submitted automatically and students can still review what they submitted.
help.due: Set a deadline to close the lesson like that automatically.
help.back: Take back only works while no student has started.
help.results: Students do not see right or wrong while working and submit once. Tick Show results on submit to show scores and answers right away; otherwise they see them after you grade.

classPage.noLessons: This grade has no lessons yet.
classPage.releaseTitle: Release the results of every submission (no comment needed)
classPage.closeTitle: Stop taking work; answers in progress are submitted automatically
classPage.takeBackTitle: Un-give the lesson (only while no student has started)
classPage.shuffleTitle: Each student gets their own question and option order; grading is unchanged
classPage.noStudents: The class has no students yet.
classPage.whoHint: Students not chosen still see the lesson with a lock but cannot do it.
classPage.missingHint: Students who have not submitted open lessons, nearest deadline first. Copy to send to the class group.
classPage.noStudentsCode: No students yet. Create accounts on the Students page, or give students the code {code} to join.

setup.infoFailed: Could not load the lesson details.
setup.title: Settings for giving it to class {name}
setup.dueHint: After the deadline students can no longer work, the lesson closes and unfinished work is submitted. The buttons set 21:00.
setup.pickSome: Choose at least one student, or choose the whole class.
setup.showResultsHint: Students see their score and answers right after submitting; if off, they see them when you grade or release results.

teacherHome.intro: Open a class to give lessons and follow progress and students. Students sign in with the accounts you create on the Students page (or join with the class code).
teacherHome.none: You are not assigned to any class yet. Ask an admin to assign you.

grading.intro: Submissions in the order they came in, oldest first.
grading.queueHint: Opens the first submission of a lesson in a class; saving a comment or releasing results moves on to the next student.

coursesPage.intro: Preview the grades you teach, give lessons to classes, print worksheets.
coursesPage.none: You are not assigned to any class, so there is no grade to show.
coursesPage.help: Each lesson belongs to the grade. Click a class to give it the lesson (✓ = given: students of that class see and do it); click again to take it back.

attemptPage.released: Results released. The student now sees the score and the answers.
attemptPage.redone: Reopened. The student keeps their answers, can fix them and submit once more.
attemptPage.saved: Comment saved. The student sees it at the top of the lesson.
attemptPage.queueDone: ✓ All graded for this lesson in this class.
attemptPage.redoConfirm: Click again to let them redo it
attemptPage.notSubmitted: The student has not submitted this yet.
attemptPage.autoHint: Graded automatically on submit. The student sees results once you save a comment or click "Release results" (or right away if the class has "Show results on submit").
attemptPage.commentEx: Comment on the writing: what went well, mistakes to fix (with corrections), whether to move on or review…
attemptPage.newErrors: Add new mistakes to the student's log
attemptPage.errorEx: e.g. extra pronoun after who (the man who I met him)
attemptPage.saveTemplateTitle: Save what you wrote to insert it next time
attemptPage.trackedHint: Click "+1" when the student repeats an old mistake; change the status once it is fixed.

reviewPage.noSubmitted: Nothing has been submitted in this class yet.

dashboard.byGradeHint: Open a grade for figures per lesson, per class and per student.

pronunciation.label: Pronunciation

stress.label: Word stress

trueFalse.label: Reading - True / False
trueFalse.hint: Read the passage, then choose True or False.

reading.label: Reading - multiple choice
reading.hint: Read the passage, then choose the best answer to each question.

wordForm.label: Word form
wordForm.hint: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.

rewrite.hint: Rewrite each sentence so that it means the same, starting with the words given.
